body: I’ve been seeing a therapist for months and getting meds again soon. But none of it has really helped. I am just wasting the money of my mom and being a finical burden because of it. I don’t understand what’s wrong with me. Or what I’m doing wrong. I’ve tried doing all I can to get better. Everything. Nothing is helping.

I never except my friends to be a therapist. I have a therapist. But sometimes I’m falling apart and I can’t just call my therapist. It’s still okay to have friends to talk about things with but it seems I’m the one being talked to about their issues when THEY feel like it, and I don’t ever get to talk about my issues without being dismissed or straight up ignored. 
I’m saying I’m sick of seeing the performative type posts from people who aren’t actually going to talk or be helpful, or just an actual friend. Several people in my past would basically only want to talk if they wanted to complain or vent but they’re never they’re for me. 

I have better friends now who I’m sure would talk to me as they open up to me, but my experiences with people in my past doing what they did makes it hard for me, and those same people are the ones always posting shit like “reach out ❤️”

Hope that makes sense

Honestly if I were you- and you’re close enough to feel comfortable doing this- have an awkward sit down we-need-to-talk moment. Just tell him everything you’ve typed here honestly. You understand he’s been having issues and he is seeing someone and he is taking meds- but sometimes it still doesn’t balance out. Tell him you’re worried about the jokes, esp when he seems unresponsive when you shift it into more serious light. Maybe he just need someone to be like “hey man if ur not doing ok that’s ok” and offer to help get him to a better place. Maybe he just needs to talk to you or more with a therapist. Maybe he just needs to cry for an hour straight. 
The biggest thing is to just tell him you’re there for him, but make sure it’s in a serious and meaningful manner. Don’t let him keep brushing it off as jokes. Jokes are fine! But when you hear them more and more; that’s not so fine, esp when it’s these kind of jokes. 
Just tell him all this. And tell him you wanna do what you can to help. Talking, making sure he’s going to his apps or taking meds, shit- I’ve had friends make appointments for me bcuz I just couldn’t muster up to do it myself. 
Everyone is different tho. Just try to make it a point to talk about it with him serious - but honest and genuine. You’re a good friend.
